description_expanded: ABOUT BREAKERS: Immerse yourself in the charm of Old Florida at the exquisite Breakers located in the heart of Seaside on Pensacola Street. Just four homes away from the beach access, this original Seaside family home invites you to experience the classic elegance of a bygone era. With expansive front and back porches, Breakers offers a tranquil setting just steps from the pristine white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Experience the timeless allure of Breakers, where modern comfort meets nostalgic elegance in the heart of Seaside's vibrant coastal community. Tastefully decorated to embody the vibrant colors and distinctive charm of a traditional Florida home, Breakers exudes a warm Southern ambiance that welcomes you to relax and unwind. The screened front porch features inviting loungers, perfect for gathering with friends and savoring a refreshing cocktail after a sun-soaked day at the beach. The spacious back porch overlooks the tranquil paths, providing a serene dining area to enjoy your morning coffee while greeting neighbors in this exceptional family-friendly community. Indulge in a Mint Julep as you relax on the porch bed beneath the gentle fans, serenaded by the rustling palm trees and cheerful birdsong. Located just a short stroll through the quaint back lanes, you'll find yourself in the heart of Seaside, surrounded by food trucks, boutique shops, renowned restaurants, the iconic central square, and exclusive beach access through the private Pavilion. Don't miss the opportunity to make your dream vacation a reality at Breakers in Seaside. ABOUT THE AREA: Seaside Beach, located along the emerald shores of the Gulf of Mexico in the Florida Panhandle, is a renowned coastal community known for its idyllic white sand beaches, charming pastel-colored beachfront homes, and picturesque town center. Developed in the 1980s as a master-planned community, Seaside is often credited as a pioneering example of New Urbanism in architecture and town design. The beach at Seaside is a pristine stretch of soft white sand lapped by the turquoise waters of the Gulf, creating a serene and inviting setting for beachgoers of all ages. Visitors can relax on the beach, swim in the crystal-clear waters, build sandcastles, and enjoy various water activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling. One of the distinctive features of Seaside Beach is its iconic pastel-colored beach cottages and vacation rental homes, each featuring unique architectural styles that contribute to the community's character and charm. These charming homes create a postcard-perfect backdrop for leisurely strolls along the beach or through the town center. In addition to its natural beauty, Seaside Beach offers a vibrant town center with quaint shops, boutique galleries, gourmet restaurants, food trucks, and lively open-air markets. The central square serves as a gathering place for community events, concerts, outdoor movie nights, and festivals, creating a lively and engaging atmosphere for residents and visitors alike. Seaside Beach is also known for its pedestrian-friendly design, with tree-lined streets, bike paths, and walkable neighborhoods that encourage outdoor activities and social interactions. The community's commitment to sustainable and environmentally conscious practices further enhances its appeal as a destination that values both natural beauty and thoughtful development. Overall, Seaside Beach embodies a harmonious blend of coastal beauty, architectural innovation, and community spirit, making it a beloved destination for those seeking a quintessential beach escape on the shores of the Gulf of Mexico. BEACH ACCESS: * Seaside Private Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Access is included to Seaside Swim and Tennis Club with its private tennis courts, 3 swimming pools, and playgrounds. * Includes Swim and Fitness Passes (3 pools, heated in the cooler months) * Short walk to the beach * Private Beach * 4 bikes included * 6 beach towels PARKING: * Free Parking up to 2 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * All reservations are final and there are no refunds for any reason. Please inquire about or purchase travel insurance when booking your vacation with Paradise Properties * The rental agreement has to be signed within 48 hours of booking to secure your reservation. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build lasting memories for all our guests.
